# TrueCallCheck

> TrueCallCheck is a free, privacy-first caller identification and phone number analysis utility for Indian (+91) phone numbers.

## Overview
- **Name**: TrueCallCheck
- **Website**: https://goutamhx.github.io/TrueCallCheck-Web/
- **Author**: Goutam Septa (https://www.imgoutam.dev/)
- **Pricing**: 100% Free forever (No subscription, No paywall, No account required)
- **Supported Region**: India (+91)
- **Coverage**: Indian Mobile Operators (Airtel, Reliance Jio, Vi - Vodafone Idea, BSNL, MTNL)

## Key Features
- **Phone Lookup**: Enter any 10-digit Indian phone number to find subscriber name, father's name, registered address, email, carrier, and telecom circle.
- **Record Categorization**:
  - *Main Records*: Direct registered subscriber details for the queried phone number.
  - *Alternative Records*: Linked or secondary telephone lines detected under the same subscriber profile.
- **Zero-Tracking Privacy**: No queries or personal lookup data are stored or logged on servers.
- **Multiple Platforms**:
  - Web Application: Browser interface with dark and light mode support.
  - Android APK: Lightweight mobile package for on-the-go lookup.
  - Telegram Bot: Interactive bot (@advancelookupbot) for in-messenger lookup.

## Endpoints & Architecture
- Web Application: Static React single page application hosted on GitHub Pages.
- API Backend: `https://true-call-check.vercel.app`
  - Lookup: `GET /api/truecallcheckapi?newKey={10_digit_number}`
  - Notice / Status: `GET /web-notice`
  - Chat Assistant: `POST /api/chat` { "message": "string" }
